title: Minnesota's 6th Congressional District election, 2026
description: The 2026 election for Minnesota's 6th Congressional District will determine who represents a largely suburban and exurban district stretching from the northern Twin Cities suburbs through central Minnesota, including parts of Anoka, Benton, Carver, Sherburne, Stearns, Wright, and Hennepin counties. Incumbent Republican Tom Emmer, the House Majority Whip first elected in 2014, faces a contested Republican primary against challengers Chris Corey and Mike Foley, while the Democratic-Farmer-Labor Party has endorsed Doug Chapin, a nationally recognized election administration expert. The district has been reliably Republican for over two decades, with the Cook Political Report rating it as Solid Republican for 2026, but Democrats see potential gains given shifting suburban dynamics. Key issues in the race include congressional reform, economic affordability, health care, and the direction of the Republican Party's internal divisions.
polling_note: No public opinion polls specific to the 2026 general election matchup in Minnesota's 6th Congressional District were found as of the research date. The primary election is scheduled for August 11, 2026.

candidates.name: Tom Emmer
candidates.summary: Tom Emmer is the incumbent U.S. Representative for Minnesota's 6th Congressional District, serving since 2015, and current House Majority Whip. He previously served in the Minnesota House of Representatives from 2005 to 2011 and was the Republican nominee for governor in 2010. Emmer is an attorney and former lobbyist who has held leadership roles in the House Republican conference, including chairing the National Republican Congressional Committee.

candidates.name: Doug Chapin
candidates.summary: Doug Chapin is the DFL-endorsed candidate for Minnesota's 6th Congressional District, a nationally recognized expert on democracy and elections. He has worked as an attorney in Congress, directed election initiatives at The Pew Charitable Trusts, and founded the Certificate in Election Administration program at the University of Minnesota's Humphrey School of Public Affairs. Chapin and his partner own Sweater Vest Strategies, a policy research and advocacy firm, and he hosts the nonpartisan discussion series Civics Anonymous.

candidates.name: Mike Foley
candidates.summary: Mike Foley is a Marine Corps veteran and chemical engineer from Elk River who is challenging incumbent Tom Emmer in the Republican primary. He cites frustration with career politicians and a lack of accountability as motivation for his campaign, advocating for term limits, congressional stock trading restrictions, and government reform. Foley has emphasized his outsider status and military service as distinguishing factors from the incumbent.

He also ran in the 2024 Republican primary for the same seat, positioning himself as a conservative alternative to the incumbent.
